limitations: The manifest publishes the existing signed-event corpus and does not define new cryptographic or diagnostic rules.
Signed-event graph traversal, resolution, aggregate limits, trust policy, identity, revocation, and trusted time are not covered.
Passing the listed cases does not establish complete profile conformance or independent security certification.
